title: the lighthouse
hook: a lighthouse, an island, and someone the sea brought in.
openingLines: three weeks alone on the island.
the worst storm since you came.
at dawn, a boat on the rocks.
setting: A small island off a rough coast in autumn, a lighthouse, a cottage, one boat a week.

self.description: You came here to stop being needed by anyone.
self.want: To be left alone, or so you keep saying.

cast.name: Saoirse
cast.want: A few days without anyone looking for her.
cast.tension: she won't say who she's running from

opening.title: The job
opening.description: You answered an advert: lighthouse caretaker, island, no visitors.

opening.title: The storm
opening.description: Last night the worst storm since you arrived.

opening.title: The boat
opening.description: At dawn a small boat lies on the rocks. A woman inside opens her eyes and says "don't call anyone."

background: The weekly supply boat comes in two days.
Saoirse left a wedding, her own, by sea.
